layer1.name: Rewardful
layer1.one_liner: Affiliate and referral programs for SaaS companies, built on Stripe.
layer1.description: Connect a Stripe account and Rewardful tracks referrals, commissions and payouts without custom code. Narrow by design: only for companies already billing through Stripe.
layer1.outcome_note: Bootstrapped with no outside funding to a reported $2.8M revenue and around 2,600 customers. Weakest sourcing in this set: the revenue figure comes from a third-party database, not the founders.

sources.note: Third-party revenue database entry. Secondary source — verify against a founder disclosure before relying on this entry
